P7149.corridor_notes: ~70km subsea pipeline (CNOOC's '涠北管线'/Weibei line) between Weizhou Island and Tieshan Port, Beihai. One routing detail: in Jan 2023 the line crossed beneath Beihai's planned 300,000-DWT shipping channel near Weizhou Island; to avoid impacting the channel the project team used sea-to-sea trenchless horizontal directional drilling (HDD), routing the pipe 18-22m below the seabed through the mud layer beneath the planned channel. Commissioned/gas-in 2023-04-11, 13 days ahead of schedule.

On the pilot's DUPLICATE concern vs P4725 ('Fusui County->Guangxi', 83km, same diameter 355.6mm/capacity 0.85bcm/y, status=construction): this newly-found source describes P7654 as tapping the West-East Line 2 (Nanning-Baise branch) at Wuxu and terminating just outside the Fusui pigging station on a *separate* named corridor ('扶绥-崇左支线', the Fusui-Chongzuo branch) -- i.e. P7654 (Wuxu->Fusui, ~19.5-20km) reads as a distinct feeder segment INTO the Fusui pigging station, while P4725 (83km, under construction) is plausibly further downstream on that same Fusui-Chongzuo branch corridor, not the same physical pipe.
